text: I've been a patient here for many years. Today, I came in with a toothache. I had an appointment with Dr. Janya two days in advance. I endured the pain, finally met Dr. Janya, and had an X-ray. After waiting for a while, a staff member called me to pay and said the schedule was full for the day and I would have to come back next Tuesday. It was Saturday. I asked if I could have the doctor examine my tooth first, but the staff member just kept saying the schedule was full. I pressed them again, asking if the doctor had referred me to a root canal specialist, but they gave the same answer – the schedule was full. It was like talking to a rock; they didn't understand that I had already endured pain waiting for the doctor once, and now I have to wait another three days. I kindly request the management team to improve their service.

text:
The first time was enough. It's incredibly expensive, much more than other clinics. They charge a ton of fees and don't inform you of the price before the procedure. Other clinics charge 500-600 baht per side for a filling.
This clinic charges 2,000 baht per side. OMG! 😱 The most important point is that they don't inform you before the procedure. If I had known the price, I wouldn't have done it.
I was shocked when I got the bill. I was really shocked by the price.
Filling 2,000 baht per side.
Scaling 1,500 baht.
Professional service fee 150 baht.

If it's so expensive, why don't I go to another clinic? Why come here?
If I had known the price would be so high, I wouldn't have gone.
If they had informed me of the price beforehand, I wouldn't have done it.
My regular clinic is full. It's my bad luck. There are so many clinics out there, but I don't go.
I wanted to review and compare prices for anyone considering using their services. I'd like the clinic to review their pricing process beforehand and make sure they offer reasonable prices.
